caveats: Profile runs include observers and are not clean TPS samples. v15 versus v17 also includes accepted v16 reader changes, so this is attribution, not an isolated eager-release A/B.
Logcat timestamps are rounded to milliseconds. Gaps before expert registration match reader wait location, but also include ordinary host scheduling; per-layer wait counters were not enabled.

No host-reader claim/finish timestamps are logged, so initial host bank completion or reader idle intervals cannot be measured. Earlier host-bank completion causing later pipeline slack remains a hypothesis.
Reader CPU masks are observed placement unions, not throughput or concurrency measurements.
